claims: The USWNT is currently playing a three-game friendly series against Japan in April 2026.
USWNT vs. Japan match is scheduled for April 14, 2026, at 7:00 PM PDT at Lumen Field, Seattle, WA.
USWNT vs. Japan match is scheduled for April 17, 2026, at 6:00 PM MDT (approx 8 PM ET) at DICK'S Sporting Goods Park, Commerce City, CO.
The matches are broadcast in English on TNT, truTV, HBO Max.
The matches are broadcast in Spanish on Universo, Peacock.
The USWNT recently completed the SheBelieves Cup in March.
The USWNT secured wins against Argentina, Canada, and Colombia in the SheBelieves Cup.
